skills.name: build
skills.description: Build a new game economy on Magicweave — currencies, stats, a game-loop manifest, leaderboards, or a spin wheel — from a concept, end to end. Use when the user wants to create, author, scaffold, or ship a new game or economy on Magicweave (the MCP server named "magicweave" must be connected).
headings: Before you start — read the source of truth
The pipeline (phases are gates — do them in order)

skills.name: guardrails
skills.description: The Magicweave hard rules and guardrails. Read before any Magicweave backend work — authoring definitions, wiring a game loop, or editing a live economy — to avoid the classic hallucinations. Use whenever a task touches the Magicweave API, MCP tools, currencies, stats, game manifests, leaderboards, or spin wheels.

skills.name: maintain
skills.description: Safely edit, tune, or audit a live Magicweave game — change an economy, add or adjust a leaderboard, retune a spin wheel, or trace what references a definition. Use when the user wants to modify, migrate, rebalance, or review an existing Magicweave game rather than build a new one.
